description: This file extends Drupal's AJAX functionality to integrate dialog API features, including dialog creation, management, and event handling for modal and non-modal dialogs within Drupal.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Initializes dialog behaviors, including creating modal container, handling focus, and managing dialog buttons.

methods.name: prepareDialogButtons
methods.description: Scans a dialog for primary buttons and moves them to the dialog's button area.

methods.name: openDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog with content loaded via AJAX, setting up buttons and event listeners.

methods.name: closeDialog
methods.description: Closes a specified dialog and optionally removes it from DOM.

methods.name: setDialogOption
methods.description: Sets a specific option on a dialog using jQuery UI dialog API.

methods.name: dialog:aftercreate event handler
methods.description: Binds a cancel button within a dialog to close the dialog when clicked.

methods.name: openModalDialogWithUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL in a modal dialog via AJAX.
